definitions.gloss: fast walking; brisk walking; walking quickly
definitions.explanation: Walking at a pace faster than normal, either to get somewhere quickly or as a form of exercise.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}まで{早歩|はやある}きで{行|い}った。
examples.english: I walked briskly to the station.

examples.japanese: {早歩|はやある}きは{健康|けんこう}にいい{運動|うんどう}だ。
examples.english: Brisk walking is good exercise for your health.

examples.japanese: {遅刻|ちこく}しそうだったので{早歩|はやある}きで{会社|かいしゃ}に{向|む}かったが、{結局|けっきょく}{走|はし}ることになった。
examples.english: I was about to be late, so I walked briskly toward the office, but ended up running.

notes:
A compound of {早|はや}い (fast) and {歩|ある}き (walking). Functions as a noun and can be used adverbially with で ({早歩|はやある}きで). Commonly promoted as a health exercise, especially for older adults.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早歩|はやある}きで{行|い}く: to go at a brisk walk
- {早歩|はやある}きする: to walk fast
- {早歩|はやある}きの{効果|こうか}: benefits of brisk walking
- {早歩|はやある}き{散歩|さんぽ}: brisk walking (as exercise)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {速足|はやあし}: quick pace — often written with different kanji, slightly more literary
- {小走|こばし}り: light jog, trot — faster than walking but not quite running
- ウォーキング: walking (as exercise) — loanword, commonly used in fitness contexts
